horoscope: You can sometimes feel restless today, dear Aries, but the underlying desire is to refresh your mind and spirit. It helps that you see more angles to a story or layers to an issue today. Uranus has recently turned retrograde, and this yearly, five-month cycle is currently occurring in your communications sector. Uranus has a way of pulling some repressed feelings to the surface, yet you may not feel that you can express them smoothly or fully. In the months ahead, however, you’ll find different–and possibly more satisfying–channels for representing and expressing yourself. You could re-examine some of your projects or interests, which have recently been sporadic or sudden. Today, you're in generally good shape for networking, connecting, and sharing.

You may be focusing on resolving an emotional or private matter today, dear Taurus, but restlessness can be stirring, or distractions are plenty. Uranus has recently begun its yearly five-month retrograde cycle, and even with some worry about finances or moving around of funds, you’re ultimately heading towards a whole new way of living. As you rewrite what you value most, the respect you attract into your life evolves. You are discovering unique natural talents, learning to embrace and develop them, and letting go of old dependencies or crutches. The coming months will help you work on inner attitudes that need to change so that you can move forward more confidently. It’s also a time to dream up inventive ways to make money or review and refine current projects. Today, find moments to detox, relax, decompress, and detach.

The Moon's move into your solar seventh house today stirs your desire for companionship, dear Gemini. Still, relating isn't always straightforward today as the Moon opposes Uranus in your sign, which can arouse some rebelliousness in you. While you tend to have the support of others energetically speaking, you are more inclined to want to go about things at your own pace. Uranus has recently begun its yearly five-month retrograde cycle, turning some things inward as you get in touch with what drives you, particularly if you’ve felt restless or on edge. Examine which fears or attitudes have limited your independence and personal truth. Plans can stall or slow down, whether because of circumstances or because you are not quick to make changes or take personal risks. While Uranus was direct and in your sign in recent months, your confidence in pursuing new experiences and expressing your independence has been evident. With Uranus now retrograde until February 8th, more is happening inside you than on the surface on these levels. Fortunately today, you’re inspired to grow, improve, explore, and discover, and new ideas can inspire you.

With the Moon's move into your work and health sector today, dear Cancer, the desire or need to attend to your duties and routines is in focus. You want to be useful or productive now. Still, with the Moon's opposition to Uranus, sticking to the task isn't always easy or straightforward. Uranus, currently transiting your privacy sector, helps you break free from elements of your life that have prevented growth. The more you let go of the weight of secrets and inauthentic behavior, the freer you feel to be yourself. Uranus has recently begun its retrograde cycle, and until February 8th, you'll tend to process recent events and changes and work through your feelings about putting things behind you. It’s a powerful time for unusual dreams and strong hunches or coincidences. Today, as you gain more self-acceptance and enjoyment, you may tune in to greater feelings of purpose and meaningfulness.

With the Moon opposite Uranus today, dear Leo,  something--or someone--can catch you off guard. Routines are especially dull to you temporarily. Uranus has recently begun its retrograde cycle, and for almost five months, things tend to calm down on the social front. This valuable period runs until February 8th, helping you process recent changes and events with friends and preventing impulsive, regrettable decisions. When you act from your heart rather than merely react to others and circumstances, you do yourself a service during this retrograde phase. Today, enjoying alternative activities with a partner or connecting with someone significant through mind-expanding experiences or non-routine activities can figure strongly. You’re finding a greater sense of personal meaning and purpose through your contacts and explorations.

With the Moon's move into your solar fourth house today, dear Virgo, you're drawn to your home or personal life. Still, with the Moon opposite Uranus, if you've been feeling stressed or limited and constrained, it can be a challenge to settle in. Uranus has recently begun its yearly five-month retrograde cycle, inspiring you to examine needs related to your long-term goals, career, or reputation. You’ve been reshaping your reputation and carving out a unique identity, mainly through your status or profession. Now, it’s time to analyze, plan, and reassess. This cycle lasts until February 8th, and it’s a strong time to review. Easing back or detaching from things can help you see your life path goals and ambitions in a new light. Fortunately today, helping can be satisfying, and you can experience new feelings of inspiration regarding your daily affairs, psychological health, or an intimate relationship.

You're drawn to your personal interests today, dear Libra. Still, with the Moon's opposition to Uranus, it can be difficult to concentrate in some areas. Circumstances tend to remind you, generally through tension, about areas of your life that need updates and reforms. Uranus has just recently begun its yearly five-month retrograde. Uranus has encouraged an “upgrade” of sorts with ninth-house matters, where it’s transiting, such as belief systems, education, publishing, and communications. If you’ve been making changes too quickly in these areas, however, this retrograde phase helps you restore balance. Until February 8th, it’s a time to process recent changes, beliefs, and experiences. Fortunately, today, you feel more fulfilled with greater attention to creativity, imagination, and recreation.

Comfort needs are strong on your mind today, dear Scorpio, with the Moon's move into your solar second house. Strong outer-planet transits this week support a greater sense of belonging and connectedness. You might improve relationships with family and co-workers through increased understanding. You could be discovering more meaning and purpose through your job, wellness programs, or family initiatives. With Uranus retrograde until February, it's a generally good time to examine how you depend on others and devise strategies to alter dependencies in ways that benefit you and the people you love. If financial or support matters have been up in the air, disorganized, or unreliable, now’s your chance to figure out why. This retrograde cycle subtly shifts how you approach change, upgrades, and progress with your intimate life, finances, and debts.

Relationships are a little complicated in spots today, dear Sagittarius, but you're feeling a little freer to be yourself today. With Uranus now retrograde, there can be a shift in perception, particularly in a relationship. Uranus is currently transiting your partnership sector, and this yearly, five-month retrograde cycle prompts some meaningful introspection and examination of your relationship needs. Even if unreliability issues are temporarily not as prominent, exploring your inner need for change can greatly benefit you. You may even need a relationship overhaul to feel more in control when Uranus turns direct again in February. With the Neptune-Pluto transit strong this week, you're in particularly good shape for guiding, learning, and advising. People are drawn to you and your ideas. You may be finding more meaning and inspiration in what you’re doing, which makes everything feel more rewarding. It’s a good time to expand your mind and connect with others through the mind. Extending help or finding new things to love about someone can be a pleasant focus.

The Moon heads into your privacy sector today, dear Capricorn, and getting in touch with true needs and wants can be a priority. Remind yourself that you need some breathing room, especially with the Moon opposing Uranus today. Uranus has only recently begun its yearly five-month retrograde cycle, helping you slow down and examine or even reconsider recent changes related to your daily routines, work, and health. These areas of your life may have been up and down, and looking inward for answers makes sense during this phase that lasts until February. You’re seeking more truth in your work or the services you provide. Your mission now is to help your “future self” deal with unpredictability and change more effectively. With a Neptune-Pluto transit strong this week, you're in generally good shape for finding a stronger sense of purpose or meaning through your home life, business, or family. You can accomplish far more than usual when you feel dedicated. There is excellent energy for forgiveness or acceptance in relationships, particularly with family. It's easier to overlook the small problems and see the value of your connections overall.

With the Moon opposite Uranus today, dear Aquarius, there can be some feelings of unrest stirring, and it would be wise to sort out frustrations. You may vacillate between wanting to do something on your own and wanting others' involvement. However, expressing yourself through spontaneous, interesting, and perhaps unusual activities can be especially rewarding. You can be quite pleased with your projects, studies, and connections this week as Neptune and Pluto harmonize. Uranus has been encouraging you to express yourself more authentically and creatively during its long-term transit of your sector of joy. With its recent retrograde turn, you’re inclined to slow down with these changes. Life is less about spontaneously reacting and more about considering which reforms are best for you in the long run while Uranus is retrograde until February 8th. Creative projects, and possibly even relationships, can benefit from review and refinement.

The Moon heads into your responsibility sector today, dear Pisces, putting you into a goal-oriented frame of mind. The Moon opposite Uranus today may trigger frustrations that have been working under the surface. Ideally, they help you deal with a problem area, but watch for an impatient, restless approach that ultimately sets you back. Uranus has recently begun its yearly five-month retrograde cycle, and during its long-term transit of your solar fourth house, some up-in-the-air elements related to your home or personal life can pop up. With Uranus retrograde until February 8th, you might catch your breath and examine what you need and want along these fronts. Your attitude toward security, dependence, attachment to the past, and family or domestic life will keep evolving. In the months ahead, you might aim to recognize and adjust your responses to the world so changes feel less random. With a slower pace, you have a better chance of understanding what’s going on around you.
